summary: Frontend-only design overhaul test. Static/SSR rendering is correct across all 7 tool pages + landing (hero, session card, surfaces grid, footer, navbar). However, CLIENT-SIDE HYDRATION IS UNRELIABLE in the running dev build — ThemeToggle (data-testid=theme-toggle) never appears in DOM after cold navigation, and Radix nav-more dropdown + CommandPalette do not open in response to clicks or ⌘K/Ctrl+K. Backend /api/health returns 200 degraded as expected. No runtime ReferenceError/TypeError in console; only WS/HMR 502 noise (dev-mode HMR blocked by ingress) and a blocked Cloudflare beacon (CSP).

ui_bugs.issue: Button never appears in the navbar — `useEffect(()=>setMounted(true),[])` never fires because the client bundle for the Navbar tree does not hydrate. As a result, the empty `<div className='w-8 h-8' />` placeholder stays and the theme cannot be toggled from the UI. data-testid='theme-toggle' is not present in DOM after multiple 30s+ waits and hard reloads.

Clicking [data-testid=nav-more] does not open the menu — no elements with role='menuitem' or portal links appear. Flights/Hotels/Restaurants/Visa entries are only reachable via direct URL. Root cause is the same hydration failure.

Palette does not open via ⌘K, Ctrl+K, or by clicking [data-testid=nav-command-trigger]. [data-testid=command-palette-input] never mounts. `Enter` navigation and `Escape` close cannot be verified end-to-end.

Check-in / Check-out use the browser's native <input type='date'> picker (see screenshot 07/25/2026 with OS calendar icon) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover component the design brief asks for. Same likely applies to any other tool page using date inputs.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot verify — palette never opens due to hydration issue.

issues: HMR websocket returns 502 on the preview ingress, spamming the console with reconnect errors. Consider disabling HMR client on preview or setting a custom webpackDevMiddleware/allowedDevOrigins pattern that covers *.cluster-XX.preview.emergentcf.cloud (log shows blocks for that host).
CSP blocks Cloudflare Insights beacon (script-src). Either add https://static.cloudflareinsights.com to script-src or drop the beacon in dev.

action_items: PRIMARY: Investigate why client components in the navbar tree fail to hydrate on the preview deployment. Likely candidates: (a) Sentry client init throwing before hydration completes, (b) Providers/QueryClient/next-themes SSR mismatch causing hydration abort silently, (c) turbopack dev build serving stale/mismatched chunks. Test with `next build && next start` in the container to see if this is a dev-only turbopack issue. Also add `5f177e3f-*.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud` (or a broader wildcard) to allowedDevOrigins — current `*.preview.emergentcf.cloud` does not match multi-level subdomains and the logs confirm blocks.
Replace native <input type='date'> in Hotel Finder (and other tool pages) with the shadcn Calendar + Popover pattern per the design brief.

Once hydration is fixed, re-verify: ThemeToggle switches data-theme attribute and body background, More dropdown reveals 4 items linking to /flights /hotels /restaurants /visa, ⌘K opens CommandPalette, typing 'plan' filters to Trip Planner, Enter routes to /planner, ESC closes.
Consider removing Cloudflare Insights beacon or whitelisting its host in CSP to eliminate the console error.
critical_code_review_comments: components/ui/ThemeToggle.tsx: The `mounted` gate returns an unstyled placeholder that intentionally hides the button until after hydration. When hydration fails silently there is no visible fallback and no error surface — consider rendering an accessible button skeleton or logging a hydration error.

next.config.ts: `allowedDevOrigins` uses `*.preview.emergentcf.cloud` but the ingress serves subdomains like `xxx.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud` (3 levels). Next's wildcard is single-segment, so cross-origin HMR is being blocked (see frontend.err.log). Use explicit multi-level entries or a broader glob.
components/Navbar.tsx: The 'nav-more' dropdown items are keyed only by `href`. If any two secondary items share an href, React will warn. Non-blocking today but worth guarding.
hotels page: uses native <input type='date'>, inconsistent with the design brief's shadcn calendar direction.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing page SSR content is all correct: hero H1 renders as two spans ('A quieter way' / 'to plan travel.') — string-contains checks pass but exact-text locators need to allow the newline. All 7 surface cards present with correct hrefs (surface-card-the-itinerary-studio, ledger, sightseeing, flights, stays, table, border). All 7 tool routes render their Instrument Serif H1 correctly. Footer has Wayfare/Product/Legal/'Always verify before booking'. Hero CTAs point to /planner and /budget. Backend /api/health returns {status:'degraded', services:{groq:false,serper:false,exa:false,rapidapi:false}} — expected. The blocker is client hydration: theme-toggle, Radix DropdownMenu (nav-more), and CommandPalette do not become interactive. On the very first run of a fresh Playwright session the theme-toggle briefly appeared in DOM (visible=true) but subsequent cold nav attempts and reloads reproducibly show 0 count even after 30s of waiting. This is likely a Next.js dev/turbopack + Sentry + next-themes hydration mismatch. Reproduce with: goto('/'), wait 15s, `page.locator('[data-testid=theme-toggle]').count()` — expect >=1.
rca of the issue: Symptom: any client component that gates rendering on `useEffect`/mounted, or that requires client JS to open (Radix DropdownMenu, custom CommandPalette keyboard listener), never becomes interactive. Server-rendered links (nav-planner, hero-cta-primary, surface cards, footer links) work because they are pure anchors. Suspected cause: hydration is aborting/failing silently in the preview environment. Contributing factors observed in logs and network: (1) HMR websocket returns 502 through the ingress; (2) `allowedDevOrigins` in next.config.ts uses a single-level wildcard so Next dev blocks cross-origin fetches from cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud hosts (log confirms); (3) Sentry client wrapper (withSentryConfig) is enabled — a failing Sentry init or DSN mis-config can silently break hydration on Next 15. Mitigation to try in order: (a) build & serve prod (`next build && next start`) to eliminate turbopack/HMR variables; (b) broaden allowedDevOrigins to include *.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud and *.cluster-*.preview.emergentcf.cloud; (c) temporarily disable Sentry (SENTRY_DSN empty or bypass withSentryConfig) and verify hydration; (d) check next-themes SSR mismatch by setting `suppressHydrationWarning` on <html> in layout and defaultTheme='dark' with disableTransitionOnChange to prevent flash-based mismatch.
